description:
Assemble a ready-to-paste prompt that primes any coding agent (Codex, Copilot, Claude Code, etc.) to GENERATE accessible code on the first try. It injects either a specific component's ARIA contract or the general WCAG ruleset, the framework/platform-specific requirements, and the mandatory post-generation verify chain (audit → release gate → manifest). This is the same builder Malimbe's UI prompt tools use — identical output either way.

Use this when a user is about to ask an agent to build UI and you want the request to bake in accessibility rather than bolt it on afterward.

Args:
  - task (string, optional): what to build. Required if component is omitted.
  - component (string, optional): a known pattern to inject its full contract. Available: button, text input, link, checkbox, radio, dialog, menu button, listbox, grid, tree view, tree grid, date picker, tabs, accordion, combobox, tooltip, design system.
  - framework, platform, wcag_level: target environment and conformance level.
  - design_system_kind / design_system_ref: point the agent at an existing source of truth.
  - design_system_image_data_uri: optional inline screenshot (small files only) when design_system_kind is 'screenshot'.
  - design_tokens: raw tokens (CSS vars, JSON, or name:value pairs) to use verbatim instead of inventing new ones.
  - include_tests, include_mcp_setup, agent: payload shaping.

Returns: a single prompt string.

agent.description: Target coding agent — only affects the MCP setup snippet's syntax.

component.description: Optional known pattern to inject its full contract. Available: button, text input, link, checkbox, radio, dialog, menu button, listbox, grid, tree view, tree grid, date picker, tabs, accordion, combobox, tooltip, design system.

design_system_image_data_uri.description: Optional inline screenshot as a data: URI (small files only — large ones are dropped and only the filename/description in design_system_ref is kept). Only used when design_system_kind is 'screenshot'.

design_system_kind.description: Source of truth to conform to, if any. 'figma'/'xd'/'screenshot' are design-file sources (visual/interaction spec) — never rendered artifacts, so they can never satisfy the automated release gate on their own; the built code still needs its own deployed/package/ci-build provenance. 'screenshot' is a single static image: no hover/focus/disabled/error/loading states or keyboard behavior can be inferred from it alone.

design_system_ref.description: Reference for the source (URL, pkg@version, repo@SHA, a Figma/Adobe XD file/frame link, or a screenshot file path/description). Required if design_system_kind is not 'none'.

design_tokens.description: Raw design tokens (CSS custom properties, a token JSON blob, or plain name:value pairs) to use verbatim instead of inventing new ones.

framework.description: Target framework for the generated code.

include_mcp_setup.description: Include MCP tool setup and the mandatory post-generation verify chain (audit → gate → manifest).

include_tests.description: Ask the agent to also produce interaction/focus/state tests.

platform.description: Target platform — adds the relevant touch-target/zoom/screen-reader considerations.

task.description: What to build, e.g. "a searchable country picker". Optional if `component` is set.

wcag_level.description: WCAG 2.2 conformance level to build to.

name: a11y_build_prompt
title: Build an accessibility-primed prompt
